capability.problem: Test whether optically maintained localized inverted recombination supplies electrical gain through displacement current.
capability.current_best: Optically pumped masers and optical source plus RF electronics are demonstrated comparator classes; no matched advantage here.
capability.limitation: Fixed-interface kinetic field slope,orientation and physical losses unmeasured; illustrative gain small and noisy.
capability.proposed_mechanism: Field-stabilized charge dipoles recombine faster in an inverted regime,delaying population depletion and potentially supplying negative electrical absorption.

target.conditions: Upper uncertainty bound strictly below0 at constant optical pump/zeroDC with actual device losses included.
target.comparator: Matched optical source plus RF electronics/maser; total pump,noise,loss,lifetime and acquisition budget.

potential_significance.judgement: A successful displacement-current gain assay could establish a scientific mechanism; exceptional technological value UNKNOWN.
potential_significance.limits: No aggregate score,TRL,physical validation or inferred capability advantage.

contract.governing_equations: Y=Y_passive+sN q^T(sI-L)^-1 b; source restricted two-state/rotation model and multicomponent sensitivity detailed in README.
assumptions: Localized dipole and acquired kinetic field response; static-mixture model is a possibility,not identified dynamics.
Published hexane kinetics require remeasurement in actual host; no free solvent transfer.
contract.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Optical pump pays for work; complete absorbed/reflected light,luminescence,heat,electrical work and stored-energy changes required.
contract.materials: Named CdS-alizarin foothold; continuum dielectric constants,hole centroid and orientation unmeasured; no qualified specimen.
contract.units_and_tolerances: Conditional90MHz -5.43nS against~.1mS susceptance;~1e-5rad phase target and loss tangent<~5.24e-5 are requirements,not achieved specs.
contract.input_acquisition: Actual-host kinetics,formation/recombination field slopes,dipole/rotation,leakage,carrier/contact and dielectric loss; all calibration charged.
contract.error_budget: Statistical/systematic complete-device bound; leads de-embedded,physical sample losses retained; adaptive frequency selection explicitly accounted.
contract.energy_balance: Conditional .272pW weak-probe contribution versus minimum6.67mW productive absorbed pump,plus all auxiliary/preparation costs; no claimed efficiency advantage.
contract.reliability: Photodamage,dose,chemical stability,containment,host dispersion,insulation,leakage and thermal drift UNKNOWN.
contract.resources: Subnanosecond/GHz timing/readout,calibrated RF network,optical pump/heat removal and controls; no equipment purchase or physical experiment.
